title: Fix Kit App Design Entry in Sketchpad
description: Fix Kit App Design Entry in Sketchpad
summary:
Fixed design entry in Kit app by resolving two issues:

1. `useSyncDeep` returns a single value but was destructured as an array (`const [canUndo] = useSyncDeep(...)`) in KitToolbarSelection, DesignSelectSettings, and QualitySelectSettings (6 call sites total). This caused "useSyncDeep is not a function or its return value is not iterable" crash, breaking the Kit app's event handling chain including double-click navigation.

2. Kit diagram (KitDiagramInner) was missing `onNodeDoubleClick` handler, so double-clicking nodes in the force-directed diagram view never navigated to the design.

Fixes applied:
- Removed array destructuring on all 6 `useSyncDeep` calls → `const canUndo = useSyncDeep(...)`
- Added `handleNodeDoubleClick` callback to KitDiagramInner that navigates to design/type/quality on double-click

Verified with Playwright diagnostic: double-click on design row now navigates to `/kits/{kit}/designs/{design}`.
All tests pass: elements/ui (34/34), compose/js (174/174), root vitest (174/174).
